notes.title: On Point 1.0 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
On Point is officially on its way out of Early Access!!!

We’re super excited to announce that On Point 1.0 is coming in Q4 2025 - just in time for the holidays!



We’ll be sharing a full list of the planned changes soon, but here’s a quick look at some what’s coming:
[previewyoutube="wnk9xgVlLEM;full"][/previewyoutube]New Features & Gameplay Enhancements
Arcade tickets for content unlocks/progression

New Tickets, Scores, and Lives UI

New environment & new minigames


New Game Modes
One-Off Mode: Master your favourite mini-game

Marathon Mode: Every single mini-game in a row. Yep, all of ’em.


Quality of Life Improvements
Ambient lifetime stats

Refined UI and menus

notes.title: Version 0.1.31
notes.notes:
We’ve upgraded to newer versions of Unity and associated XR packages. 

Changed:

 You’ll notice some minor lighting changes, in the move to newer versions we’ve rebuilt lighting in almost every environment.

Fixed:

 Resetting view/origin should now behave as expected in more situations. 


Thanks to everyone for feedback and reporting issues. We heard from comments and in the discord there were issues around resetting view, and that was a big factor in approaching upgrading engine versions.

Keep shooting straight.

notes.title: Early Access Update 3: Halloween!

Added:


 Skeleton Surprise:  Skeletal foes leap from the graves—take aim and catch them mid-air before they disappear back to the underworld.

notes.title: Update 2 is Live!
notes.notes:
Update 2 is here! Bringing with it CocoNut Chaos to crack, Gophers to get after, user settings to tweak controller alignment, and a suite of background element interactions.

Added:

 Coco Chaos minigame now in rotation
 Go-no-Gopher minigame now in rotation
 Settings options to manually adjust pitch and yaw of the gun
 Background element interactions and animations


Changed:

 Aim assist algorithm tweaked, distant targets will now demand more precision
 More interactive, decal surfaces


Watch out for some spooky surprises in the near future.
Keep shooting straight.

notes.title: Announcing Update 2: More Minigames!
notes.notes:
More Content on it's way!
We're thrilled to share a sneak peek of two new minigames and some improvements we're working on! 

🥥 Minigame 1: Coco Chaos 
Where the coconuts come from, no one is quite sure. But they’re erratic, joyous bouncing makes them oh so shootable. Remaining focused and keeping your accuracy up is a challenge amongst the chaos.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800804/9c60b8549d17a1300463885fe6f788db951443d0.png

🐭 Minigame 2: Go-no-Gopher 
We wouldn’t trust these Punxsutawney pranksters with the weather forecast, and they’re probably more Mole than Gopher. They have a mission for you though, shoot these chicken cutouts, reacting to motion alone is going to get you into big trouble.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800804/08e09d76775d5b5d535b11cf8093cca1634f58ba.png

⚙️ Settings: Rotation Fine Tuning
A number of requests from the community for settings to fine tune the pitch and roll of the gun relative to the controller. While there are grander plans for such matters in the future, if you felt your aim was always a bit to the left or too low, you’ll now be able to make some minor adjustments in the settings to better align to your natural posture.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800804/1e684dc0e18c86e4a4324c1e16f5d0e6489d4217.png

These additions, along with some visual improvements, and background interactive elements should be released in the coming weeks.

Keep shooting straight.

[previewyoutube=KwnT-vckUC4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Announcing Update 1: New Upcoming Minigames!
notes.notes:
Exciting New Minigames Coming Soon to "On Point"! 
We're thrilled to share a sneak peek of three exhilarating new minigames that will soon join the "On Point" lineup. Check out the action-packed preview in our latest YouTube video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BqUy3ICOIH8

🪰 Minigame 1: Delicate Destruction
Those pesky flies have got into the China shop again. You've tried doing as much damage, as quickly as possible in the China shop already, this time the goal's NOT to break the finery. Shoot the flies, without damaging the environment. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800804/daafd2dacec7accbba8a6f9f38fc458b0cca7218.png

🐟 Minigame 2: Piranha Peril
Get ready for some aquatic action in "Piranha Peril"! These ravenous piranhas are on the move, and it’s your job to stop them before they can wreak havoc. Aim carefully and shoot swiftly to keep the waters safe. Dive into the challenge!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800804/2c03acf969181dcf30455e77f4c3dd4e1e91f3ec.png

🪂 Minigame 3: Parachute Pandemonium
Look to the skies in "Parachute Pandemonium" where targets are descending on parachutes. Your mission? Shoot the targets without missing a beat as they float down, swinging side to side.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800804/f39d1d7e299c19ec46591659a39876c45d733158.png

More to come!
We're incredibly excited and grateful for the fantastic reception our early access launch has received. Your feedback and enthusiasm have been overwhelming, and we're eager to keep the momentum going with these new additions. Stay tuned for more updates and keep the bullets flying!

Keep shooting straight, and thanks for being an essential part of our community!
